summary: Generate and independently validate three HomeBrain dedicated-motherboard enclosures, including four direct-thread PCB posts per case, tall USB-load walls, lid bosses, PMS5003 airflow control, onboard-antenna keep-outs, STL files, Blender source, and exploded previews.
outputs: Three body STLs with 12 verified open-top/closed-bottom motherboard pilots, 12 verified open-top/closed-bottom lid pilots, six 18 mm-high USB-load walls, three matching recessed screw lids, verified onboard-antenna corridors, an Atmosphere PMS5003 perimeter shroud/divider behind separate intake/exhaust grille banks, a structured .blend source with 24 reference screws and PCB/RF/mount/airflow metadata, three 1000x700 exploded previews, one 1600x1000 LinkedIn fleet render, and a hash/geometry manifest.
side_effects: Replaces only generated enclosure artifacts inside hardware/homebrain-sensors/enclosures/generated/.
